text:
erin: Quick check-in: sequence-window stability milestone — where we at on kernel patches + KV eviction tweak? I'm consolidating blockers for Friday demo. @matt @jia

matt: Kernel PRs are green but still seeing a 2-3% throughput dip on long sequences in the perf harness. digging into scheduling hotspots.

jia: KV eviction patch landed on dev, but we haven't run the canary with continuous-batching enabled. need a dep: ops to provision 3 canary runners in us-west2.

ops-bot: Canary request received: 3 runners in us-west2 queued (ETA ~22m).

kevin: I can take ops follow-up. pinged infra-alloc for quota, should be resolved in ~30m.

luis: Noted perf dip. I ran `bench/run_long_sequence.sh --iters=300` — logs show spike at step ~120 when KV miss rate increases. sharing logs: https://internal/logs/abcd

matt: Thanks @luis — I think the kernel latch around kv-load is holding threads. I have a small patch (WIP) to split the load path; it's in my branch `matt/split-kv-path`.

erin: Ownership: matt owns kernel split patch, jia owns eviction + canary plan, kevin owns infra allocation. Deadline: Friday EOD for canary results. If any blockers, call it out by Thu 16:00.

jia: Canary plan: two phases — (A) continuous-batching=on, default kernel; (B) continuous-batching=on, kernel-split branch. Rollback policy: abort if 99p latency > SLO*1.2 or p50 token/sec drops >5%.

matt: PR: https://gh/redwood/runtime/pull/4321 — WIP tests passing locally. Need one more code review @jia @kevin (esp. kernel scheduling bits).

kevin: Looking now. heads-up: alloc teams requested explicit machine labels `hotpath=true` for canary pools. jia can we add that to the canary request?

jia: Yep, will add label. Also adding an `--enable-kv-prefetch` flag to the canary via runtime flags.

luis: Potential dependency: optimizer team merged a change to async-io that might affect our kernel scheduling. @erin should we coordinate a call with them before Friday?

erin: Yes let's do quick 30m sync tomorrow 10:30. I'll send calendar invite. If anyone can't make, add notes in thread. :calendar:

matt: :thumbsup: I'll drop a short runbook snippet after tests. snippet:
```
# canary run steps
1) provision pool
2) deploy kernel-split
3) enable continuous-batching
4) monitor 5m rolling windows
```

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary job queued for 2026-08-05T15:40Z (job id canary-175999).

jia: Added CPU/mem thresholds to canary config, and a quick alert: `runtime.kv.miss_rate > 0.4` -> page.

kevin: Confirmed infra quota, pool created with label hotpath=true. kicking off canary once matt's branch is merged.

erin: Thanks team. If you have any immediate blockers, DM me. Will post a brief summary after the Friday demo.
